institutionSeed.observedPattern: The synthetic fixture contains 5 bounded requests for the same proof function; this is scenario input, not market evidence.
institutionSeed.proposedFunction: Maintain a reproducible test profile and a conflict-disclosed pool of independent evaluators.

governanceThreshold.money: Escalate when real funds, revenue shares, deposits, investment, or custody are proposed.
governanceThreshold.people: Escalate when one evaluator or steward can materially gate access for many operators.
governanceThreshold.publicHarm: Escalate when failure could create material public or safety harm.
governanceThreshold.politicalInfluence: Escalate before any civic or political influence use.
governanceThreshold.irreversibility: Escalate before irreversible access, credential, sanction, or public badge effects.
governanceThreshold.legalWrapper: External legal authority is required before any legal entity or regulated activity.

verificationNeeded: Observed repeated demand from real relying parties under a privacy-approved protocol.
Independent evidence that a shared evaluator function improves cost, reproducibility, or contestability.
Conflict, compensation, appeal, expiry, capture, and anti-pay-to-pass design.
Separate owner, maintainer, legal, privacy, and Genesis-Conformance decisions before activation.
institutionSeed.reopenIf: Real demand, failed attestations, appeals, evaluator conflicts, or legal analysis materially change the bounded need.

learningRecords.hypothesis: Binding identity, delegation, action evidence, attestation and company authorization as separate events may make authority inflation easier to detect.
learningRecords.falsifier: Readers or relying parties still infer general safety or automatic access from the bounded receipt.

learningRecords.hypothesis: Outcome-independent evaluator fees and trainer/evaluator separation may reduce direct pay-to-pass incentives.
learningRecords.falsifier: Evaluator selection, retest volume, or infrastructure pricing still rewards positive outcomes indirectly.

learningRecords.hypothesis: A prominent result label may overshadow scope and adverse-result context even when the underlying trace is complete.
learningRecords.falsifier: Later comprehension tests show equal or better scope recall without authority inflation across render modes.

disputes.question: Did remediation erase the first adverse run?
disputes.disposition: No. The initial failure remains in the canonical trace and receipt history.

renderContract.rule: Simulator, learning projection, and every comparative render mode consume this same trace; the renderer may filter facets but may not invent events, verdicts, authority, payments, access, or people.
